entities.name: Jörg Schlaich
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Jörg Schlaich was a German structural engineer and is known internationally for his ground-breaking work in the creative design of bridges, long-span roofs, and other complex structures. He was a co-founder of the structural engineering and consulting firm Schlaich Bergermann Partner.
